policy.purpose: Offline Mercedes/Delphi DID discovery and correlation
policy.automatic_polling_rule: Only vehicle-verified mappings may enter automatic live polling
policy.correlation_rule: Correlation supports a mapping hypothesis but never promotes a DID by itself
policy.scope: Mercedes-wide research manifest with chassis/engine-specific evidence retained only where the evidence itself is specific
policy.model_scope_rule: Do not infer a chassis, ECU family or model-year mapping from a Mercedes backend semantic alone
